result.brief: 提出免训练时空 token 剪枝框架 PreSTP，利用去噪轨迹早期干净估计构建跨帧与跨步冗余掩码，加速少步自回归视频扩散并抑制长时漂移。
result.reason: Training-free token pruning for few-step autoregressive video diffusion; directly serves video generation efficiency and long-video generation, though it is an inference-acceleration method rather than a representation contribution.
